rows.text: The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the Base Rate at its current level (5.00%) for the intermeeting period.
The domestic economy is exhibiting some signs of a slowdown in its pace of expansion.
While exports continue to post robust growth, domestic demand has moderated.
There still remains a high degree of uncertainty surrounding future economic developments, largely due to the international financial market unrest and the US economic slowdown.
Consumer price inflation continues to show a rapid rise, mainly influenced by high oil prices.
The recent rebound in real estate prices has continued centering on certain areas.
Liquidity is still ample in the financial markets and financial institutions' lending continues to show a steady increase.
Meanwhile, long-term market interest rates have declined sharply.
